# Dragon-Q8B: free and full profiles

These features need artifacts that nixpkgs does not allow with `allowUnfree = false`, so only the full profile includes them. Blocked artifacts are not packaged in any profile.

## boot-firmware

| Features | Artifact | Class | Available in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| dragon-q8b-uefi-update | `dragon-q8b-firmware.uefi` | R2 | blocked: licensing |

## runtime-firmware

| Features | Artifact | Class | Available in |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| dragon-q8b-adsp | `dragon-q8b-firmware.adsp` | R2 | full |
| dragon-q8b-audio | `dragon-q8b-firmware.audio-topology` | R2 | blocked: licensing |
| dragon-q8b-compute-dsp | `dragon-q8b-firmware.cdsp` | R2 | blocked: licensing |
| dragon-q8b-gpu | `dragon-q8b-firmware.gpu-gmu` | R2 | full |
| dragon-q8b-gpu | `dragon-q8b-firmware.gpu-sqe` | R2 | full |
| dragon-q8b-gpu | `dragon-q8b-firmware.gpu-zap` | R2 | full |
| dragon-q8b-qup | `dragon-q8b-firmware.qup` | R2 | blocked: licensing |
| dragon-q8b-video | `dragon-q8b-firmware.video` | R2 | blocked: licensing |
